angle: Unlike other L10 materials that fix a cutoff or compute a named statistic, this one builds null-and-alternative intuition purely from a 100-card binomial story contrasting a weak 28-hit outcome against an extreme 44-hit outcome.
angle_detail: Start with [00:57]–[02:58] because the null binomial model and the as-good-or-better tail calculation motivate everything that follows. Then watch [02:58]–[05:01] for the null-versus-alternative framing and the extreme-case contrast that shows what strong evidence looks like. Note the course gap: the video never fixes a significance level or computes a named test statistic, and it stresses hypotheses about parameters rather than sample summaries, so pair it with a video that executes a decision rule.
